verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API with a list-items endpoint that supports filtering by level, environment, status and pagination. Its published OpenAPI 3.1 spec has Item and Occurrence resource tags, and tokens are scoped (e.g. a post_client_item token that cannot read data). However, updating items via the API and fetching raw occurrence payloads are only implied by the spec tags, not shown in endpoint documentation. missing for 10: explicit documentation of item update (status/owner) endpoints, explicit occurrence/raw-event fetch endpoints, detail on read/write scopes, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can list, query, and update issues and fetch raw events through a documented REST API with scoped tokens

citations.quote: The Rollbar API provides a RESTful interface to much of the data in the system.
Get the first page of items that are error or critical, in the production environment
Use a separate client-side token with post_client_item scope only.
The client-side access token can only be used to send events and only from client-side platforms. It can't be used to read any data
